repos.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: HelloGitHub 是一个专注于分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的月刊，每月28日定期发布，涵盖有趣项目、开源书籍、实战及企业级项目。旨在通过精选优质开源内容，帮助用户快速发现开源魅力，激发学习兴趣，降低入门门槛，从而爱上开源生态。
repos.summary_en: HelloGitHub is a monthly publication that curates and shares interesting, beginner-friendly open-source projects from GitHub. Released on the 28th of each month, it features engaging projects, open-source books, practical tutorials, and enterprise-level codebases to help newcomers discover the joy of open source and build real-world skills quickly.

repos.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了30,000+行关于主流AI编程工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Devin AI等）的系统提示、内部工具和模型架构的深度解析，涵盖其设计理念、功能实现与技术细节，为开发者提供全面的AI编程助手技术洞察与最佳实践参考。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains over 30,000 lines of insights into system prompts, internal tools, and AI models of major AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Devin AI), offering deep technical analysis of their architecture, functionality, and design principles for developers seeking to understand and leverage AI-powered development tools.

repos.description: :cn: GitHub中文排行榜，各语言分设「软件 | 资料」榜单，精准定位中文好项目。各取所需，高效学习。
repos.summary_zh: GitHub中文排行榜是一个按编程语言分类的中文开源项目榜单，涵盖软件与资料两类，提供总榜、增速榜和新秀榜，帮助开发者高效发现优质中文开源项目，降低语言障碍，提升学习效率。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Chinese Top Charts is a categorized ranking system of high-quality Chinese open-source projects by programming language, featuring software and knowledge categories, with overall, growth, and new repo rankings to help developers discover and learn from top Chinese projects efficiently.

repos.description: :zap: Dynamically generated stats for your github readmes
repos.summary_zh: GitHub Readme Stats 是一个动态生成 GitHub 统计信息的项目，可自动在个人 README 中展示仓库贡献、语言使用、活跃度等数据，支持高度自定义主题、布局与指标，提升开发者主页展示效果。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Readme Stats dynamically generates GitHub statistics for READMEs, displaying repository contributions, language usage, activity metrics, and more. It supports customizable themes, layouts, and options to enhance developer profile visibility.

repos.description: A list of cool features of Git and GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是 GitHub 和 Git 的高级功能速查表，涵盖隐藏特性如忽略空白符、分支对比、行号高亮、任务列表、Emoji 支持、Gist 使用、Hub 工具等，帮助开发者提升工作效率，适用于日常开发协作与代码审查场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a comprehensive cheat sheet of advanced Git and GitHub features, including whitespace ignoring, branch comparisons, line highlighting, task lists, emoji support, Gists, Hub CLI, and more—designed to boost developer productivity in collaborative coding and code review workflows.

repos.description: The uncompromising Python code formatter
repos.summary_zh: Black 是一个无妥协的 Python 代码格式化工具，强制统一代码风格，提升团队协作效率。它基于 AST 分析实现确定性格式化，支持 Python 3.10+ 及 Jupyter Notebook，提供极小 diff 输出以加速代码审查，并内置语法有效性验证确保代码安全。
repos.summary_en: Black is the uncompromising Python code formatter that enforces consistent style across projects. It reformats entire files in place using AST analysis, supports Python 3.10+ and Jupyter Notebooks, produces minimal diffs for faster code reviews, and validates syntax safety through built-in AST checks.

repos.description: 🃏 A magical documentation site generator.
repos.summary_zh: Docsify 是一个神奇的文档站点生成器，可将 Markdown 文件直接转换为静态网站，无需构建流程。支持全文搜索、多主题切换、插件扩展和 Emoji 渲染，适用于快速搭建技术文档、项目说明等轻量级网站。
repos.summary_en: Docsify is a magical documentation site generator that converts Markdown files into static websites without requiring a build process. It features full-text search, multiple themes, plugin support, and emoji rendering, ideal for rapidly building lightweight technical documentation and project wikis.

repos.description: Free, simple, fast interactive diagrams for any GitHub repository
repos.summary_zh: GitDiagram 是一款免费的交互式 GitHub 仓库可视化工具，可将任意仓库结构秒级转换为系统架构图。支持点击组件跳转源码、导出 Mermaid 代码或 PNG 图片，集成 OpenAI GPT-5.2 实现智能分析，提供私有仓库支持与自托管部署方案，适用于快速理解复杂代码库。
repos.summary_en: GitDiagram is a free, fast tool that converts any GitHub repository into interactive architecture diagrams in seconds. It leverages OpenAI GPT-5.2 for intelligent analysis, supports clickable navigation to source files, exports Mermaid/PNG formats, and offers private repo support with self-hosting capabilities for deep codebase understanding.

repos.description: A simple, Git-powered wiki with a local frontend and support for many kinds of markup and content.
repos.summary_zh: Gollum 是一个基于 Git 的轻量级 Wiki 系统，支持多种标记语言（如 Markdown、AsciiDoc 等），提供本地前端界面和版本控制功能。它允许用户通过 Git 仓库管理 Wiki 页面，支持实时编辑、历史回溯、数学公式、图表（Mermaid/PlantUML）、BibTeX 引用等高级功能，兼容 GitHub/GitLab Wiki，适合团队协作与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Gollum is a Git-powered wiki system that enables version-controlled, human-editable text files organized in a Git repository. It supports multiple markup languages, real-time editing, page history, diagrams (Mermaid/PlantUML), math rendering, citations, and integrates seamlessly with GitHub/GitLab wikis for collaborative documentation.

repos.description: Git your game on!
repos.summary_zh: Githug 是一个通过游戏化方式学习 Git 命令的实践工具，包含多个难度递增的关卡，每个关卡要求玩家使用特定 Git 命令达成目标。它基于 Ruby 开发，支持跨平台运行，提供提示、重置和关卡列表功能，适合 Git 初学者系统掌握版本控制技能。
repos.summary_en: Githug is a practical game designed to teach Git through interactive levels. Each level challenges users to use specific Git commands to achieve a goal. Built in Ruby, it runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows, offering hints, resets, and level progression to help beginners master version control effectively.

repos.description: 【🔞🔞🔞 内含不适合未成年人阅读的图片】基于我擅长的编程、绘画、写作展开的 AI 探索和总结：StableDiffusion 是一种强大的图像生成模型，能够通过对一张图片进行演化来生成新的图片。ChatGPT 是一个基于 Transformer 的语言生成模型，它能够自动为输入的主题生成合适的文章。而 Github Copilot 是一个智能编程助手，能够加速日常编程活动。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目深入探索了基于编程、绘画与写作的AI应用，涵盖StableDiffusion图像生成、ChatGPT文本创作及GitHub Copilot代码辅助。通过Prompt工程实践，系统解析了AI模型在图像描述、文章构思与代码生成中的交互逻辑，并提出了'Prompt编程'概念，探讨自然语言驱动软件开发的可能性。
repos.summary_en: This project explores AI applications in programming, painting, and writing through StableDiffusion image generation, ChatGPT text creation, and GitHub Copilot code assistance. It systematically analyzes how AI models interact with human input via prompt engineering for image description, article structuring, and code generation, proposing the concept of 'prompt programming' as a bridge between natural language and software development.

repos.description: Visible multi-agent CLI workspace for mixing Codex, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, Cursor, Copilot, Pi, OpenCode, and other AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: CCB（Claude Codex Bridge）是一个多AI智能体协作平台，支持Claude、Codex和Gemini等模型的实时协同工作。通过项目级团队管理、命名代理通信和持久化上下文，实现零拷贝的任务委派与广播同步，适用于复杂开发流程的自动化协作场景。
repos.summary_en: CCB (Claude Codex Bridge) is a real-time multi-AI collaboration platform enabling seamless coordination between Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It features persistent context, minimal token overhead, named agent communication, and project-level team management for efficient AI-driven development workflows.

repos.description: Modern photo gallery for photographers, with S3/GitHub sync, EXIF details, maps, and a WebGL viewer.
repos.summary_zh: Afilmory 是一款专为摄影师打造的高性能现代照片画廊平台，支持 S3/GitHub 同步、EXIF 元数据展示、地理地图可视化和 WebGL 渲染，提供响应式瀑布流布局和国际化支持，适用于自建或 SaaS 部署。
repos.summary_en: Afilmory is a modern, high-performance photo gallery platform for photographers, featuring S3/GitHub sync, EXIF metadata, interactive maps, and WebGL rendering. Built with React + TypeScript, it offers responsive masonry layouts, multi-storage support, and HDR/Live Photo compatibility for professional photo curation.

repos.description: GitHub notifications alike app for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-notifications 是一个专为 Django 设计的 GitHub 风格通知系统，基于 Activity Streams 规范构建。它通过 Actor、Verb、Action Object 和 Target 四元组模型实现灵活的事件通知机制，支持任意 Django 对象间的关联，适用于构建用户动态、活动提醒等场景。
repos.summary_en: django-notifications is a GitHub-style notification system for Django, built on the Activity Streams specification. It uses a four-component model (Actor, Verb, Action Object, Target) to create flexible event-based notifications, supporting arbitrary Django object relationships for user activity feeds and real-time alerts.

repos.description: 😁 git commit message emoji 使用指南
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供了一套中文化的 Git Commit Emoji 使用指南，涵盖 30+ 个常用 emoji 及其对应代码，用于规范提交信息格式，提升代码历史可读性与团队协作效率。支持命令行显示 emoji，适用于多平台开发场景。
repos.summary_en: This repo provides a comprehensive guide for using Git commit emojis in Chinese, including 30+ emoji codes and their meanings to standardize commit messages, enhance code history clarity, and improve team collaboration. It supports emoji display in terminals and is suitable for cross-platform development.

repos.description: [废弃] {官方中文马上就来了} GitHub 汉化插件，GitHub 中文化界面。 (GitHub Translation To Chinese)
repos.summary_zh: GitHub 汉化插件为英文基础薄弱用户提供中文界面支持，通过 Tampermonkey 实现 GitHub 全站翻译，帮助新手快速上手。插件每日自动更新翻译内容，支持 Chrome、Opera 等主流浏览器，并提供手动安装指南。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Hans is a Tampermonkey-based plugin that translates GitHub's full interface into Chinese, aiding users with limited English proficiency. It auto-updates translations daily and supports major browsers like Chrome and Opera, with clear installation instructions.

repos.description: AI资讯日报 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 驱动的内容聚合与生成平台。它每日为您精选 AI 领域的最新动态，包括行业新闻、热门开源项目、前沿学术论文、科技大V社交媒体言论，并通过 Google Gemini 模型进行智能处理与摘要生成，最终自动发布到 GitHub Pages 生成 AI 日报。
repos.summary_zh: AI资讯日报是基于Cloudflare Workers构建的自动化内容聚合平台，每日精选AI领域新闻、开源项目与学术论文，通过Google Gemini生成智能摘要并发布至GitHub Pages。支持Folo订阅源接入，提供网页、RSS及微信公众号多端阅读体验，兼具技术学习价值与个人定制潜力。
repos.summary_en: AI Insight Daily is an automated content aggregation platform built on Cloudflare Workers. It curates daily AI news, open-source projects, and research papers, generating intelligent summaries via Google Gemini and publishing them to GitHub Pages. Supports Folo RSS feeds, offering multi-platform access via web, RSS, and WeChat Official Account, serving as both a learning resource and customizable tool.

repos.description: 🐒一些修改自网络的油猴脚本 Some Tampermonkey scripts modified from the internet
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供一系列基于油猴脚本（Tampermonkey）的自动化工具，多数脚本改编自网络资源，涵盖网页功能增强、界面优化及实用小工具。所有脚本均托管于GreasyFork平台，支持多语言版本，具备高安装量和良好用户评价，适用于提升日常浏览与操作效率。
repos.summary_en: This repository hosts a collection of Tampermonkey user scripts, mostly modified from online sources, designed to enhance web functionality, optimize interfaces, and provide utility tools. Hosted on GreasyFork with multi-language support, these scripts boast high installation counts and positive user ratings, ideal for improving browsing efficiency and user experience.

repos.description: Hacknical, hacker & technical. A website for GitHub user to make a better resume.
repos.summary_zh: Hacknical 是一个专为 GitHub 用户打造的在线简历生成平台，通过深度分析用户的 GitHub 贡献、代码仓库、技术栈等数据，自动生成可视化分析报告，帮助用户打造专业、数据驱动的编程简历。支持中英文切换、组织账号分析、移动端展示及 PDF 导出，技术栈涵盖 React、Koa2、MongoDB 等。
repos.summary_en: Hacknical is a web platform designed for GitHub users to generate data-driven resumes by analyzing their GitHub contributions, repositories, and tech stacks. It provides visual analytics and exportable reports, supporting English, organizations, mobile viewing, and PDF export with a tech stack including React, Koa2, and MongoDB.

repos.description: 一个"制造技能的技能"。这个工具自动化了将任意 GitHub 仓库转换为标准化技能的全过程，是扩展 AI Agent 能力的核心工具。
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: 一个"制造技能的技能"。这个工具自动化了将任意 GitHub 仓库转换为标准化技能的全过程，是扩展 AI Agent 能力的核心工具。
repos.summary_zh: GitHub Skill Forge 是一个自动化工具，可将任意 GitHub 仓库一键转换为 AI Agent（如 Trae）可直接调用的标准化技能包。通过云端扫描、智能 RAG 提取核心代码与文档，生成上下文文件，无需本地克隆或复杂配置，显著提升 AI 助手处理开源项目的效率。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Skill Forge is an automation tool that transforms any GitHub repository into a standardized skill package for AI agents (e.g., Trae) to directly understand and invoke. It performs cloud-based scanning, smart RAG extraction of core logic and docs, and generates context bundles without local cloning or complex setup, dramatically improving AI efficiency in handling open-source projects.

repos.description: 完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App | Completely free, open-source, collaborative accounting Web App
repos.summary_zh: Cent 是一款完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App，基于 GitHub 仓库实现数据同步与版本控制，无需服务器即可跨平台实时协作。支持语音记账、AI 智能分析、多币种管理、地图可视化、周期记账等高级功能，采用纯前端 PWA 架构，数据完全自持于用户私有仓库，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Cent is a completely free, open-source collaborative accounting web app that uses GitHub repositories for data synchronization and version control, enabling real-time cross-platform collaboration without servers. It supports advanced features like voice记账, AI analysis, multi-currency management, map visualization, and recurring transactions. Built as a pure frontend PWA with data stored in user-owned private repositories for full privacy and security.

repos.description: A list of the most popular AI Topic repositories on GitHub based on the number of stars they have received.| AI相关主题Github仓库排名，每日自动更新。
repos.summary_zh: GitHub-Ranking-AI 是一个每日自动更新的 GitHub AI 仓库排名系统，按星标数量统计热门 AI 主题项目。涵盖 LLM、ChatGPT、OpenAI、DeepSeek、RAG、AI Agents 等前沿领域，提供 AutoGPT、Ollama、LangChain、Dify 等顶级开源工具榜单，是开发者追踪 AI 技术趋势的核心资源库。
repos.summary_en: GitHub-Ranking-AI is a daily-updated ranking system of the most popular AI repositories on GitHub based on stars. It covers cutting-edge topics like LLM, ChatGPT, OpenAI, DeepSeek, RAG, and AI Agents, featuring top tools such as AutoGPT, Ollama, LangChain, and Dify. Serving as a vital resource for developers to track AI trends and discover high-quality open-source projects.

repos.description: GithubAction的使用样例，天气推送，薅羊毛，打卡签到
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为 GitHub Actions 实战样例，演示如何通过无服务器 Python 程序实现自动化任务。核心功能包括跨平台画爱心程序构建、微信公众号天气推送及京东签到薅羊毛。通过 Secrets 管理敏感信息，支持定时任务调度，适合学习 CI/CD 与自动化运维。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides practical examples of GitHub Actions for serverless automation. Key features include cross-platform executable generation (e.g., drawing hearts), weather push notifications via WeChat Official Account, and JD.com daily check-in 'money-saving' bots. It uses GitHub Secrets for secure credential management and cron-based scheduling.

repos.description: 净化Github搜索页，屏蔽cirosantilli等400+人的敏感仓库。
repos.summary_zh: GitHub搜索净化是一款浏览器脚本，通过屏蔽敏感用户（如CiroSantilli等400+人）的仓库，实现搜索结果页面的内容净化。支持完全隐藏或提示屏蔽、模糊/精确匹配模式，并提供五种检测机制（推荐MutationObserver），兼容Tampermonkey和Chromium内核浏览器，显著提升GitHub搜索体验。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Search Purification is a browser script that cleans search results by blocking repositories from sensitive users (e.g., CiroSantilli and 400+ others). It offers options to hide or flag blocked repos, supports fuzzy/exact matching, and uses five detection modes—recommending MutationObserver—for compatibility with Tampermonkey and Chromium-based browsers, enhancing search clarity.

repos.description: A super blog lite -- just one page. use vue with github api !
repos.summary_zh: 基于 GitHub Issue 的单页极简博客系统，使用 Vue 和 GitHub API 构建，支持自定义配置与 CI/CD 自动化部署，适合个人知识管理与轻量级内容展示。
repos.summary_en: A minimalist single-page blog built with Vue and GitHub API, powered by GitHub Issues for content. Supports custom configuration and CI/CD via GitHub Actions for static site deployment.

repos.description: Detect file modification in background and push it to git automatically.
repos.summary_zh: file_sync 是一个轻量级自动化工具，通过监听文件变化并自动提交到 Git 仓库，实现配置文件的实时同步与版本追踪。支持跨平台运行，可设置开机自启，适用于个人配置文件管理场景。
repos.summary_en: file_sync is a lightweight automation tool that monitors file modifications in the background and automatically pushes changes to a Git repository, enabling real-time synchronization and version tracking of configuration files. It supports cross-platform operation and can be configured to run at system startup.

repos.description: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。
repos.summary_zh: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars 仓库，利用 AI 生成智能摘要与技术标签，支持并发处理、增量更新及多端同步（Obsidian/GitHub Pages），实现高效个人知识管理与技术检索。
repos.summary_en: Automatically fetches GitHub Stars repositories, generates AI-powered summaries and technical tags, supports concurrent processing, incremental updates, and syncs to Obsidian or GitHub Pages for efficient knowledge management.

repos.description: 工作生活的唠叨/随笔、折腾备忘, 同时分享下观看的影视、减肥动起来的记录等。Hugo theme and personal blog system with essays, microblog-style updates, browser publishing and life data.
repos.summary_zh: Koobai/blog 是一个个人博客仓库，专注于记录工作生活感悟、技术折腾笔记及日常软件推荐。内容涵盖影视观后感、减肥健身打卡等生活化主题，兼具实用性与分享性，适合追求轻量化知识沉淀与兴趣交流的开发者。
repos.summary_en: Koobai/blog is a personal blog repository focused on daily life musings, technical experimentation notes, and software recommendations. It covers topics like movie reviews, fitness tracking, and lifestyle tips, offering a blend of practical insights and casual sharing for developers seeking lightweight knowledge documentation.

repos.description: 基于service worker与单页面应用的静态页面博客系统
repos.summary_zh: swBlog 是一个基于 Service Worker 和单页应用（SPA）的静态博客系统，支持 Markdown 写作、离线阅读与搜索功能。可部署于 GitHub Pages 或 CDN，具备文章分类、标签生成及自动化构建流程，适用于个人技术博客与知识分享场景。
repos.summary_en: swBlog is a static blog system built with Service Worker and SPA, supporting Markdown writing, offline reading, and search. Deployable on GitHub Pages or CDN, it auto-generates categories/tags from file structure and enables automated builds via npm scripts for personal tech blogs.
